reviews.comment: He took over for Mo, so this may not apply for future classes. He's nice, but I think he goes over theory too much, and his lectures are a little hard to follow. Grade is mostly determined by 3 exams. Last 2 exams were hard. I suggest you study hw and lectures for exams. He gave 8 points of extra credit on the final grade, so everyone passes.

Lenient grading on hw and tests. Hw is similar to tests. A lot of extra credit designed so doing average on exams will get you an A. He is nice. I missed one extra credit and got 89. He is a bad lecturer. His details on exams were misleading. His slides dont cover the material well, self study through a book instead of just reading slides.

He took over our 303 class (FREE MO!). No clue what was happening in lecture, but he records it, so I never went. Very theory heavy and wish he gave more practice problems. He gave 8 extra points to final grade from extra credit which was absolutely awesome.

He genuinely cares about his students and has very straightforward lectures. There's also an absurd amount of extra credit (12 quiz questions, with each attempt worth a full point added to your overall grade) and he grades exams very generously. The workload is very manageable. The class material was just not easy to digest.
Responds very quickly to emails, is very generous with partial credit on his exams, and genuinely cares about his students. Take him if you can!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great prof.  Tons of opportunities for extra credit.  Takes difficult material and makes it easy to understand.  The last few units are a bit of a stinker, as it shifts from being more concept-heavy to calculus-heavy, but definitely manageable.  Office hours are very helpful.  Highly recommend if you want a reasonable workload for 303.
Mr. Qian made this class a lot easier than what I've heard some of the other classes go through. He actually cares about the students and has helpful office hours. Take him if you can

Professor Xiaoning is very understanding and caring of his students and tries however he can to help. There were many opportunities to do well in his class and any grade under B is honestly on you. He sends us inspirational quotes in emails and is very kind, do take him!

Qian was not bad. While his lectures were pretty boring and not too helpful, he still really cared about you learning the material. When we didn't do well on the first exam, he actually apologized and said he would try and teach us better. He's very accessible outside of class and grades exams in like two seconds. The class is just very hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Qian is a very kind professor teaching very difficult class. Although I found his lectures to be a little unhelpful at times, he is willing to work with anyone who reaches out to him. Homeworks can be tough but professor Qian is always happy to help during office hours. Fair.ish exams if you really understand the material well.

The class is hard, explaining to students is harder. Xiaoning tried to help, and had SO SO many handouts, reviews, guides, extra prep, and then every single exam had a makeup attempt. The class is hard, and he is not the best lecturer but if you come to him with specific questions and how to. He will help, fantastic prof

Homework assignments were very difficult, but adequately prepare you for the very fair tests. Course subject matter is not necessarily easy so many people still failed the tests anyways. Because of that, he would have make ups to get a lot of points back. Gives lots of feedback, but very hard to follow and understand in lecture.

Took this class in Spring of 2020 but forgot to rate. Dr. Qian was a very humble and smart professor. His lectures were very fun and engaging. Each of the topics he discussed he really drove the passion into the student and he brought on great guest speakers. I feel like him/his class are pretty underrated and more people should take it if offered!
Great Professor, he is very understanding.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is not good at explaining stuff even though is very knowledgeable and intelligent. He tries to explain everything using maths without giving prior background about the subject. Also he is not clear when he speaks it's difficult to understand what he says. His assignment are easy but the exam are bit tough.

Dr. Qian is very intelligent and knows his material. At times he can be difficult to understand, but nothing unbearable. This course goes through lots of material, but in my opinion his tests did not seem too challenging, just study the homeworks and lecture notes.
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS
